sources.name: Awwwards
sources.bestUse: High-end interactive web composition, art direction, motion, and first-impression references.
sources.screenshotPolicy: Capture local screenshots only when publicly accessible; keep attribution and do not commit copyrighted captures publicly without approval.
sources.notes: Strong for award-level web visual direction, not a direct app template.

sources.name: FWA
sources.bestUse: Immersive interactive experiences, cinematic web, and motion-led concepts.
sources.screenshotPolicy: Local reference captures only; do not bypass access controls.
sources.notes: Best for bold interaction and immersive scene logic.

sources.name: CSS Design Awards
sources.bestUse: Awarded web composition, visual craft, and responsive art direction.
sources.screenshotPolicy: Local reference captures only when public.
sources.notes: Useful for layout and visual polish references.

sources.name: Godly.website
sources.bestUse: High-taste website references and contemporary landing-page composition.
sources.screenshotPolicy: Local reference captures only; keep source URLs.
sources.notes: Strong taste curation, not formal award proof.

sources.name: Mobbin
sources.bestUse: Mobile app flows, UI patterns, and production interaction references.
sources.screenshotPolicy: Do not bypass login or paid access; use notes/links unless access is approved.
sources.notes: Useful for mobile patterns, not always accessible without account.

sources.name: Lapa Ninja
sources.screenshotPolicy: Local reference captures only when public.
sources.notes: Good for fast survey, not deep interaction.

sources.name: Landingfolio

sources.screenshotPolicy: Local reference captures only when public.

sources.name: SiteInspire
sources.screenshotPolicy: Local reference captures only when public.

sources.name: Behance
sources.bestUse: Portfolio case studies, product UI concepts, art direction boards.
sources.screenshotPolicy: Respect creator rights; local notes/screenshots only unless approved.

sources.name: Dribbble
sources.bestUse: UI mood, component treatments, micro-compositions, and visual exploration.
sources.screenshotPolicy: Respect creator rights; local notes/screenshots only unless approved.

sources.name: Pinterest
sources.bestUse: Moodboard discovery, visual clustering, and broad aesthetic search.
sources.screenshotPolicy: Do not treat as trusted award source; do not bypass login; keep links/notes and local-only screenshots.
sources.notes: Allowed for inspiration discovery, not production proof or asset sourcing.
